logline: Lady Juliana arrives at the cathedral in her late mother's bridal gown, only to suffer the ultimate betrayal when her fiancé Gerald abandons her at the altar for her cruel sister Clarissa with her family's full blessing.
continuity_notes: First episode of the series. Establishes Juliana's humiliation and abandonment by her betrothed, Gerald, and her noble family in favor of her sister, Clarissa.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Symmetrical framing on the heavy church doors as they slowly part, pushing in slightly as Juliana stands framed in the light, dressed in an elegant white silk gown.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Juliana pauses at the threshold, her expression bright with joyful anticipation, wearing her mother's vintage gown and an oval pendant necklace.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: High wide tracking shot following behind Juliana as she steps into the grand cathedral nave, facing the distant altar flanked by seated guests.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up on Juliana's face as her warm smile begins to falter into confusion.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Juliana's eyes widen slightly in bewilderment as she notices something amiss at the altar.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium profile shot at the altar showing Gerald in his dark tailcoat holding the gloved hand of the Lady in Gold Gown, with Juliana visible walking down the distant aisle.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot as Juliana stops midway down the aisle, confronted by a haughty matriarch in black velvet stepping into the foreground.

segments.label: MATRIARCH (Cold, Commanding)
segments.speaker: MATRIARCH
segments.text: You should turn around, Juliana.

segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Confused, Breathless)
segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
segments.text: Why?

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Over-the-shoulder medium close-up past the Matriarch to Juliana, looking past her toward the altar.

segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Desperate, Unbelieving)
segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
segments.text: Gerald is waiting for me.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up on the Matriarch wearing an ornate tiara and sapphire jewelry, gazing down with merciless disdain.

segments.label: MATRIARCH (Blunt, Unforgiving)
segments.speaker: MATRIARCH
segments.text: Not anymore.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up on Juliana's stricken face as the weight of the words sinks in.

segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Trembling, Pleading)
segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
segments.text: What do you mean?

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot of the Matriarch gesturing dismissively toward the altar.

segments.label: MATRIARCH (Dismissive)
segments.speaker: MATRIARCH
segments.text: Look for yourself.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Juliana walks forward past the Matriarch, her breath hitching as she approaches the altar steps, looking up in shock.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium front tracking shot moving backward ahead of Juliana as she advances down the center aisle.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Panning shot across the seated wedding guests whispering and casting judging glances from the wooden pews.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Low-angle shot from behind Juliana looking up at Gerald and the Lady in Gold Gown standing proudly before the altar.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up on Juliana's trembling lips and shocked, tearful blue eyes.

segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Shaken, Whispering)
segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
segments.text: Gerald?

segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Heartbroken)
segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
segments.text: Why are you holding her hand?

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up insert of Gerald's fingers firmly interlocked with the white-gloved hand of the Lady in Gold Gown.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up on the Lady in Gold Gown beaming with cruel triumph.

segments.label: LADY IN GOLD GOWN (Gloating, Smug)
segments.speaker: LADY IN GOLD GOWN
segments.text: Because he is marrying me.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up on Juliana as tears spill over her eyelashes.

segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Gasping, Devastated)
segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
segments.text: No...

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Wide profile shot showing Juliana standing below the altar platform, looking up at Gerald and her sister.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up on Juliana clutching her chest, her sorrow turning into burning outrage.

segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Outraged, Accusing)
segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
segments.text: You knew this before I walked through those doors!

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot of Gerald standing stoic and impassive next to the smug Lady in Gold Gown.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up on Juliana's hands desperately clenching fistfuls of her white dress fabric.

segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Choking on Tears)
segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
segments.text: You let me come here...

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up on Juliana's tear-streaked face as she shakes with grief.

segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Crushed, Shaking)
segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
segments.text: You let me dress in my mother's gown...

segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Crying Out)
segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
segments.text: You let me believe I was walking toward my husband!

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot on Gerald stepping forward, cold and indifferent, with the Lady in Gold Gown lingering in soft focus behind him.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Tight close-up on Gerald's hardened profile as he glances down.

segments.label: THE FORMER GROOM (Cold, Callous)
segments.speaker: THE FORMER GROOM
segments.text: I changed my mind.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Extreme close-up on Juliana's furious, weeping face.

segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Betrayed, Piercing)
segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
segments.text: You swore you loved me!

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up on the Lady in Gold Gown smiling condescendingly.

segments.label: LADY IN GOLD GOWN (Mocking)
segments.speaker: LADY IN GOLD GOWN
segments.text: People change their minds, sister.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium profile shot of the Lady in Gold Gown turning her head subtly toward Gerald with satisfied malice.

segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Horrified)
segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
segments.text: And you knew?

segments.label: LADY IN GOLD GOWN (Unapologetic, Cheerful)
segments.speaker: LADY IN GOLD GOWN
segments.text: Of course I knew.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up on Juliana, stunned by the callous depth of the conspiracy.

segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Trembling)
segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
segments.text: How long?

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium two-shot of the Lady in Gold Gown and Gerald looking together down at Juliana.

segments.label: LADY IN GOLD GOWN (Cruel, Poised)
segments.speaker: LADY IN GOLD GOWN
segments.text: Long enough to know he was never going to marry you.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Juliana turns abruptly toward the first row of pews, where her elderly father sits gripping an ornate brass cane.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up on the father's hand tightly gripping the gold curved handle of his walking cane.

segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Desperate)
segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
segments.text: Father...

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Wide shot showing Juliana dropping to her knees beside her seated father, pleading with him.

segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Begging)
segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
segments.text: Tell them this is a mistake.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up on the father's weathered face, looking fixedly at the floor, refusing to meet her gaze.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up on Juliana looking up at him, tears streaming uncontrollably down her cheeks.

segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Choking, Broken)
segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
segments.text: Father... please look at me.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: The father tightens his jaw and stony expression, refusing to offer a single word or look.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Profile close-up of the father staring blankly forward.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Low-angle shot looking up at the Matriarch commanding the space with regal severity.

segments.label: MATRIARCH (Stern, Resolute)
segments.speaker: MATRIARCH
segments.text: Enough!

segments.label: MATRIARCH (Disgusted)
segments.speaker: MATRIARCH
segments.text: You have embarrassed this family long enough.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up on Juliana as she rises, stung by the utter betrayal.

segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Incredulous)
segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
segments.text: Embarrassed you?

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot of the Matriarch gesturing toward Clarissa, who stands elegantly in gold.

segments.label: MATRIARCH (Haughty)
segments.speaker: MATRIARCH
segments.text: Clarissa knows how to carry herself.

segments.label: MATRIARCH (Proud)
segments.speaker: MATRIARCH
segments.text: She has beauty, connections, and a future worth protecting.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium profile two-shot of the Matriarch confronting Juliana face to face.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up on Juliana, demanding answers in spite of her humiliation.

segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Raw, Painful)
segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
segments.text: And I am what?

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium tracking shot showing the Lady in Gold Gown stepping past Juliana toward the center.

segments.label: LADY IN GOLD GOWN (Viciously Calm)
segments.speaker: LADY IN GOLD GOWN
segments.text: You are the daughter people tolerate because they have to.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up on Juliana absorbing the venomous words, her breathing shallow.

segments.label: LADY IN GOLD GOWN (Gloating)
segments.speaker: LADY IN GOLD GOWN
segments.text: I am the daughter they choose.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot of the Lady in Gold Gown smiling warmly at Gerald beside the altar candles.

segments.label: MATRIARCH (O.S.) (Firm)
segments.speaker: MATRIARCH
segments.text: Clarissa is the jewel of this family.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close two-shot of the Matriarch and Juliana standing side by side in profile.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot framing Juliana looking directly at Gerald, who towers over her coldly.

segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Trembling, Dignified)
segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
segments.text: So that is what I was worth to you?

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up on Gerald's sharp jawline as he looks down at her without an ounce of remorse.

segments.label: THE FORMER GROOM (Scornful, Hard)
segments.speaker: THE FORMER GROOM
segments.text: You have nothing to offer me anymore.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Extreme close-up on Juliana's eye as a single tear rolls down her cheek.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Full shot tracking Gerald as he turns his back on Juliana and walks back toward Clarissa and the altar.

segments.label: THE FORMER GROOM (Arrogant, Dismissive)
segments.speaker: THE FORMER GROOM
segments.text: I cannot marry a woman of such plainness and low value...

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up on Clarissa's radiant, conceited smile basking in Gerald's words.

segments.label: THE FORMER GROOM (Reverent toward Clarissa)
segments.speaker: THE FORMER GROOM
segments.text: ...when Clarissa is the true jewel of the county.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Juliana's hand clenches fiercely into the folds of her mother's silk bridal gown, knuckles whitening with suppressed fury.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Tight insert on Juliana's white-knuckled hand clutching the gown fabric.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Push-in close-up on Juliana's tearful face. Her trembling mouth straightens, her tear-filled blue eyes hardening from sheer devastation into cold, resolute defiance.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Juliana breathes through the agony, refusing to break down further in front of the congregation.

segments.label: SOUND FX
segments.text: Solemn low-pitched string drone swells to an ominous cliffhanger peak.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Cut to black.
